courses.subject: ORLC
courses.title: Research Methods and Ethics in Otorhinolaryngology and Communication Sciences
courses.description: Clinical research goes beyond just statistics. This course lays the groundwork for understanding the ethical and epidemiological principles that guide responsible and thorough scientific investigation, particularly in otorhinolaryngology and communication sciences. Students will delve into essential topics such as research ethics, integrity, and regulatory guidelines relevant to both clinical and basic science research. The curriculum aims to build students’ abilities to use epidemiologic reasoning and ethical standards when forming research questions and choosing suitable study designs for different research situations.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MPhil-PhD Otorhinolaryngology and Communication Sciences
courses.learning_outcomes:
By the completion of this course, students are expected to:

1. Describe key principles of research ethics, integrity, and responsible conduct.
2. Recognize ethical and regulatory aspects relevant to clinical and basic sciences.
3. Apply epidemiologic reasoning to identify, define, and address research questions.
4. Distinguish among major research designs and select appropriate approaches for clinical or laboratory studies.
5. Discuss the ethical and methodological implications of artificial intelligence (AI) in health and biomedical research.

courses.title: Special Topics in Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery and Communication Sciences IV
courses.description: This course will focus on specific topics and advanced issues related to otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and communication sciences. These topics will reflect academic needs/interests, faculty expertise and student’s needs. Students are allowed to take this course more than once, and gain the units each time they pass the course. However, students cannot take the course under the same topic twice.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For student in MPhil-PhD Otorhinolaryngology and Communication Sciences
courses.learning_outcomes: To demonstrate abilities of informing oneself in depth about a specific field of knowledge relevant to the research project, as well as integrating and interpreting information in planning and implementing the research project.
